title: Arm soreness has kept Mac Jones from throwing of late

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Arm soreness has kept Mac Jones from throwing of late
sources.description: The 49ers canceled next week's mandatory minicamp, so they will wrap up their offseason program on Thursday. 49ers backup quarterback Mac Jones did not throw last week or this week as he rests his throwing arm.
